svg.title: Link capacity on a log scale
svg.desc: A vertical log axis from 10 bits per second to 10 petabits per second. Radio links on the left range from GPS at 50 b/s to Wi-Fi 7 at about 46 Gb/s. Wired and optical links on the right range from VDSL2 at about 100 Mb/s to multi-core fiber lab records above 1 Pb/s.
svg.text: Approximate peak per-link rates, log scale
